title: Explain and guide
text: A title, a description, and up to two actions that say what to do next.

title: Fits anywhere
text: Three sizes for table cells, panels, and pages; the title can be plain text inside tables.

title: Heading you choose
text: Set the heading level to fit the page outline, or none at all.

title: Announced when live
text: With live, a search that matches nothing is announced politely to screen readers.
